crop.semantics: Simulation of the current 58%-height wall image box using object-fit cover and centered framing. The crop removes only lateral background and preserves the old Count's complete white-haired silhouette, prosthetic forehead, eyes, nose, mouth, chin and collar.

notes: The selected frame visibly depicts Gary Oldman's old, white-haired Count Dracula in Bram Stoker's Dracula, not another cast member or another Dracula adaptation.

The exact /Film source page is specifically about Bram Stoker's Dracula; its retained page evidence contains Gary Oldman, Dracula and Columbia Pictures, and the selected image is captioned 'Old dracula'.
The designed face is unmistakable: heart-shaped white hair, extended prosthetic forehead, aged facial appliances, red eyes and the old Count's high dark collar.

The same source stem also exposed a WebP encoding of the same composition. That alternate encoding is rejected rather than counted as a second candidate; the JPEG byte is the selected evidence object.
The centered 1246x1000 wall crop preserves the complete face, hair silhouette, mouth and collar while removing only side background.
The candidate is not Lucy's white vampire form, Van Helsing, Jonathan Harker, Mina, a poster, logo, young-dandy publicity image, unrelated vampire, group frame or namesake.
Exact-byte duplicate screening must pass against 2,070 canonical repository hashes.
